# random_password v1.3.0 - Table of Contents

Efficiently generate cryptographically strong random passwords using alpha (including Unicode), numeric and special symbols.

## Modules

- [RandomPassword](https://random-password.hexdocs.pm/RandomPassword.md): Random Password generator.

- Exceptions
  - [RandomPassword.Error](https://random-password.hexdocs.pm/RandomPassword.Error.md): Errors raised when defining a RandomPassword module with invalid options
